resources.string:
Provides real-time captions and voice command control for video calls.
Features:
• Converts your speech to text captions
• Voice commands to control calls (mute, camera, end)
• Opens apps with voice (notes, chrome, settings)
• Works during Zoom, Meet, WhatsApp calls
This service helps deaf and non-verbal users by providing:
• Real-time speech-to-text captions
• Voice-controlled actions
• Hands-free operation
Privacy: Audio is processed only for captions and commands. No recordings are saved.
